metadata.author_role: Lead Quantitative Researcher & Research Governance Auditor
metadata.mission: Protocol normalization, candidate grid de-confliction, and freezing prior to Sprint 6.2 execution
metadata.final_governance_decision: BLOCKED — PROTOCOL OR IMPLEMENTATION ISSUES REMAIN

candidate_grid_normalization.deconfliction_methodology: Orthogonal One-Factor-At-A-Time (OFAT) sensitivity around a balanced central anchor (theta=0.40, fixed_5d exit, unconstrained pacing) plus targeted cross-factor interaction pairs. Constructed strictly using research constraints and sample size considerations, not test-period performance.

reconciliation_of_sprint_6_1_2_conflicts.description: Sprint 6.1.2 Section 5.8 listed Max Drawdown <= 15.0% under acceptance conditions, but listed Max Drawdown > 20.0% under rejection triggers, leaving a 15.01% to 20.00% ambiguous gray zone.
reconciliation_of_sprint_6_1_2_conflicts.resolution: NORMALIZED to strict 15.00%. Maximum Drawdown <= 15.00% is mandatory. Any drawdown > 15.00% triggers automatic rejection.

reconciliation_of_sprint_6_1_2_conflicts.description: Sprint 6.1.2 Section 5.3 listed Net Profit Factor > 1.15 as a secondary constraint, but omitted it from the formal acceptance conditions in Section 5.8.
reconciliation_of_sprint_6_1_2_conflicts.resolution: NORMALIZED to mandatory acceptance criterion M6: Net Profit Factor >= 1.15.

reconciliation_of_sprint_6_1_2_conflicts.description: Sprint 6.1.2 Section 5.5 specified >= 40 trades per year, but Section 5.8 only checked Total Completed Trades >= 100.
reconciliation_of_sprint_6_1_2_conflicts.resolution: NORMALIZED to mandatory acceptance criterion M5: >= 40 trades in 2023 AND >= 40 trades in 2024 (classified by entry_date).

reconciliation_of_sprint_6_1_2_conflicts.description: Sprint 6.1.2 listed friction > 100% of gross alpha as a rejection trigger without defining the condition when Gross Alpha <= 0.
reconciliation_of_sprint_6_1_2_conflicts.resolution: NORMALIZED: Strategy must generate Gross Alpha > 0 and Total Friction <= Gross Alpha. If Gross Alpha <= 0, the candidate is automatically rejected.

entry_threshold_parameter.code_evidence: Line 382 checks 'if sig == 1:', hardcoding model argmax prediction. No threshold parameter exists.

entry_pacing_parameter.code_evidence: Line 390 sets 'available_slots = self.max_positions - len(open_positions)'. No daily entry cap exists.

atr_trailing_stop_logic.code_evidence: Lines 318 and 475 only support holding_sessions >= 5 or early_exit_staged on model SELL. Zero ATR calculation or stop logic exists.

deflated_sharpe_tooling.code_evidence: Zero DSR implementation exists anywhere in src/ or tests/.
